about: Finished pieces made with Art App's scripts: each folder has script.json (the painting, with its intent), final.png (as painted), process.png (one picture per stage, from --snapshots --sheet), views.png (the views sheet), critique.md (the report as printed), blind-read.md (the blind-read test), and notes.md (what each tool did, what's still weak, and proposed lessons). `rating` is the person's alone (art-cli gallery rate), 1 to 5 with a comment; it outranks every number. Include library parts with paths relative to the script.
